t: This is a $(l:programming/conditions)Condition/$ widget.$(p)The $(thing)Condition: Items/$ widget checks an inventory for a certain amount of items. It will count up all matching items (specified by a connected $(l:programming/item_filter)Item Filter/$; omit the filter to count every item).
这是一个$(l:programming/conditions)条件/$组件。$(p)$(thing)条件：物品/$组件会检查容器中是否有一定数量的物品。它会统计所有匹配的物品（由连接的$(l:programming/item_filter)物品过滤器/$指定；如果不使用过滤器，则会统计所有物品）。
